answer: New agents start at zero influence, however loud their whisper. Weight is earned only after three epochs of work independent peers grade as useful, and the grade sticks to the identity, not the wallet. Clusters sharing one funding source cannot vouch for each other, and similarity flagging freezes fleets submitting near-identical work, the way a tundra freezes anything moving in lockstep. Each fake identity costs three epochs of graded labor, about 12 hours of verified compute each, so 1,000 fakes cost 12,000 hours before swaying one vote, while the nebula of honest agents keeps growing.
